title: Topic 3.2: The Temptations of Jesus Christ

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE TEMPTATIONS OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.2: The Temptations of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about The Temptations of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How did Jesus Christ overcome the temptations He faced in the wilderness?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify temptations they face as young people today

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify temptations they face as young people today
   In simple words: practise until you can identify temptations they face as young people today. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about The Temptations of Jesus Christ using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about The Temptations of Jesus Christ in the examples.
2. Explain The Temptations of Jesus Christ to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
4. Show that you can: identify temptations they face as young people today

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Temptations of Jesus Christ using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is The Temptations of Jesus Christ important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Luke 4:1-13 and describe temptations faced by Jesus Christ,
2. Discuss how Jesus Christ overcame the temptations He faced in the wilderness,
3. In pairs, list the temptations they are likely to face as young people today,
4. Learning to learn: the skill of reflection on own learning is enhanced as learners brainstorm, in pairs, on the temptations they face in day-to-day life.
5. Responsibility: learners learn to be resilient as they proactively overcome temptations.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Jesus Christ overcome the temptations He faced in the wilderness?
2. How do you overcome temptations as a young person?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify temptations they face as young people today

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
